response.overview: "The wind carries their names" is an experimental performance art and sound art piece that depicts the current realities of urban displacement and Indigenous queer survivance. Interpreting the sounds of three urban parks on the unceded territories of the Musqueum, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, Edzi’u examines the current realities of these three places through movement and sound as well as their relationship to land and water in territories that are not their own.
response.title: The wind carries their names
